business_problem: King needed a trusted managed Kafka partner that could support its large-scale game telemetry and reporting environment so it could retire expensive batch pipelines without destabilizing a highly tuned streaming estate used by hundreds of millions of players.
solution_summary: King chose Confluent Cloud to take over the operational burden of Kafka while preserving the performance characteristics required by its gaming analytics and reporting systems. The company had long run parallel batch and streaming pipelines, using Kafka mainly as transport, but the compute cost of batch reporting and the burden of maintaining large Kafka clusters limited its move to streaming-only operations. Confluent Cloud gave King a managed platform with the availability, stability, and collaborative support needed to migrate confidently without disrupting existing proprietary systems. With Kafka operations delegated to Confluent, the team can focus on scaling real-time reporting, shifting more workloads from batch to streaming, and building out a simpler analytics backbone for data generated by popular mobile games such as Candy Crush Saga. The transition lets King modernize incrementally while keeping the business-critical pipeline stable enough to support global player demand.
